title: Wick Liquor Contra Shattered 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Wick Liquor Contra Shattered takes the legendary Contra profile and freezes it. It features the same zesty Sicilian vine citrus and sweet Porta Fortuna fruit compote as the original, but finishes with Wick Liquor’s signature "shattered" cold effect. This delivers a sharp, frozen exhale that invigorates the senses while keeping the complex fruit notes front and center. Supplied in a 120ml bottle, this 100ml shortfill leaves space for two 10ml nicotine shots. Adding two 18mg shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Mixed with a High-VG 70% VG / 30% PG ratio, this e-liquid is optimised for sub-ohm vaping, producing dense clouds and delivering the depth of flavour Wick Liquor is famous for. Wick Liquor is a premium boutique brand from Staffordshire, renowned for their unique "big block" approach to flavour and complex, layered blends.
